map_historical_reproduction.bootstrap_note: The current campaign reuses the exact 31-October bootstrap recipe and frozen MAP records as its negative-control comparator. MAP means, reductions, seed SDs and crossed-bootstrap endpoints must match that preceding campaign. Endpoints can differ from the older September archive because that archive used a different bootstrap seed recipe.

interpretation_limits: Controls are partial ablations preserving some response-dependent information.

Pilot decoder and transformation seeds are the exact BLAKE2s seeds frozen in the 31-October input inventory; no new trace realizations are sampled. This still does not recover undocumented seeds of the earlier historical pilot.
MAP has only first-segment reconstruction with a full-response reference; transformed inputs have unequal encoder coverage.
Prompt and seed repeats are crossed, not independent new prompts; calibration/test are exact-prompt-disjoint but share scenarios.
Padding costs are payload-only; the exact 31-October random-padding realizations are retained and their costs differ from expected costs.
No transformation contrast identifies information-theoretic secrecy or semantic disclosure.
